author: Jessica Cogswell
description:
Whether Christopher Nolan’s blockbuster adaptation brought you here or you’re just a lifelong fan of Greek mythology, there’s no denying the timeless pull of The Odyssey. After all, precious few works of literature can claim to be as resonate as the nearly 3,000-year-old text, which explores longing, endurance, hubris, fate, and the human condition with a level of depth that transcends time and culture. It's also just one hell of a story, filled to the brim with memorable characters and set pieces, and all the horror and magic that makes Greek mythology so endlessly fascinating.

If watching Matt Damon navigate "the wine-dark sea" and his own guilt-laden mind left you eager to embark on an epic journey of your own, you've come to the right place. From massive open-world adventure games to mind-bending mysteries, here is a list of games you should play if you loved The Odyssey.
title: If You Loved The Odyssey, Play These Games Next

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Those itching to take Crazy Taxi: World Tour for a test drive can now sign up for their chance, as developer Sega has announced a multiplayer closed network test.

Crazy Taxi: World Tour's closed network test will run September 11-13 in the US. Those interested will need to sign up on the game's website by August 31. The test will be available on all of Crazy Taxi: World Tour's announced platforms (Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5), though Sega states on its website that certain platforms "may have limited participant capacity."

title: A Chance To Get Behind The Wheel Of Crazy Taxi: World Tour Is Coming Soon

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Grand Theft Auto Online players in Australia are no longer able to gamble in the game's Diamond Casino, after Rockstar Games appears to have blocked access in the wake of the Australian government's crackdown on online gambling.

Australian players began to report the change on Reddit (via Vice), as they were no longer able to participate in the various casino games like three card poker, blackjack, roulette, and slots, that were added to GTA Online way back in 2019 as part of the Diamond Casino heist update. This is despite the casino games using fake in-game casino chips and not real money. 

While players can technicall
title: GTA Online Players In Australia Can No Longer Gamble With Fake Money

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Remasters are good business for video game companies, but don't expect to see BioWare's Dragon Age games getting the same treatment in the future--or possibly, ever. That's according to Dragon Age series producer Mark Darrah, who says that the original trilogy of games likely won't be remastered due to BioWare losing too much institutional knowledge.

Speaking to FRVR, Darrah--who was the executive producer on the Dragon Age series--was asked about the possibility of the classic Dragon Age games being remastered, similarly to 2021's Mass Effect: Legendary Edition remaster. The former BioWare
title: BioWare Lost The Knowledge Needed To Remaster Dragon Age, Former Producer Says

author: Alessandro Barbosa
description:
We're just over halfway through the year, but it's one that has already been incredibly fruitful for Capcom thanks to its two marquee releases in 2026.

Resident Evil Requiem, the ninth installment in the enduring series, has been both a critical and commercial success, with this latest quarter being no different. Requiem has sold over a million copies this last quarter, bringing the sequel up to over 8 million units sold since its release in February.

Perhaps surprisingly, it was also one of the lowest-selling entries in the franchise over this same time period, with the remakes of R
title: Capcom Is Having A Great Year, And It Has Franchises New And Old To Thank

description:
As CD Projekt Red continues working on Cyberpunk 2, the company could have a spin-off title to tide over fans in the meantime. MP1st reports that a former WayForward employee's portfolio revealed information on a game project codenamed Gemini that relates to the Netflix series Cyberpunk: Edgerunners.

title: A Cyberpunk Spin-Off Brawler Might Be Happening At WayForward – Report

title: A Mission Worthy of Master Chief

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
PlayStation has revealed this month's batch of free games for PlayStation Plus subscribers. All PS Plus members will be able to claim a trio of freebies starting August 4: Big Walk, Dying Light 2, and Signalis. If you haven't claimed July's PlayStation Plus free games yet, make sure to do so before next Tuesday.

A day-one release, Big Walk is developed by Untitled Goose Game studio House House. If you've ever wanted to touch digital grass, then this might be the game for you, as Big Walk puts you inside of a lush open-world environment full of puzzles, tough terrain, and no real danger at all. Friends can group up to explore the great virtual outdoors, and the game features various
title: PlayStation Plus Free Games For August 2026 Revealed

author: Chris Compendio
description:
Ideally, the people involved with adapting a celebrated media franchise should be quite familiar with said franchise. But the actor bringing Link to life in the upcoming live-action The Legend of Zelda movie has a pretty good excuse for not experiencing a top-rated game of the series--at least when it launched.

Speaking to GamesRadar, Benjamin Evan Ainsworth, 17, recalled when Breath of the Wild came out in 2017. title: Live-Action Zelda Movie Actor Was Too Young To Play Breath Of The Wild When It Released

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
One of the biggest MMOs of all time, Final Fantasy 14, is coming to Switch 2 next month, and you're going to want to clear a lot of space to install the game. According to the Switch eShop listing for the game, Final Fantasy 14 will take up 117.2GB of available storage capacity, gobbling up almost half of the handheld's built-in SSD.

As for why Final Fantasy 14 is so massive, that comes down to the Switch 2 version offering the base game and its five expansions--Heavensward, Stormblood, Shadowbringers, Endwalker, and Dawntrail. Each one is a substa
title: Final Fantasy 14 On Switch 2 Is A Sobering Reminder That Storage Isn’t Cheap

author: Vic Hood
description:
In Phasmophobia, ghosts can typically be identified by gathering their three official pieces of evidence, but these aren't always available. On higher difficulty levels, ghosts leave behind fewer--or even no-- evidence to gather. Fortunately, each of Phasmophobia's 30 ghosts has unique hidden abilities, behaviors, and characteristics that you can use to determine the spooky spectre you’re dealing with or rule out potential candidates. These can include its gender, speed, the Sanity threshold it can initiate hunts at, and abilities exclusive to only one ghost type.

While identifying a ghost based solely on these unique features is critical
title: All Phasmophobia Unique Ghost Abilities: A Cheat Sheet To Hidden Behaviors

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day officially swings into theaters this week, and to celebrate the return of the webhead, Marvel's Spider-Man 2 on PS5 is getting a few upgrades. While developer Insomniac had previously revealed that the game would be updated with a new costume based on the threads worn by Spider-Man actor Tom Holland, players can also grab a slick cel-shaded costume and some PS5 Pro enhancements.

With Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls out next month, players can look forward to donning a costume that puts a fresh spin on the character. Featuring a cel-shaded design, the suit has a very anime-inspired aesthetic with its bold colors and a larger spider emblem on the chest. In comparison, the Brand New Day cos
title: Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 Swings Into A Brand New Day

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Though No More Room In Hell 2 has been playable via Steam and Epic's early-access programs for a while now, the 1.0 build is finally on the way, and it'll coincide with the game's launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. All of this arrives on August 11.

The first-person zombie game is played on large, semi-open maps and built for teams of up to eight players. If you never played the original, think Left 4 Dead, but slower and much harder. It's also less of a shooter than that genre titan, because making noise is sure to attract trouble you're better off avoiding with the use of the game's many melee weapons.

Each round plays like a run with your chosen character, and you'll progress as you sur
title: Long-Awaited Co-Op Zombie Game Is Finally Arriving Next Month

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
This week got off to a rocky start for Xbox, as a server outage saw players across the world unable to sign in, make purchases, or access their games for several hours. Those issues have since been fixed, and in a candid post online, Xbox Chief Technology Officer Scott Van Vliet spoke about what exactly happened to the Xbox network, how it was fixed, and what Microsoft will be doing to enhance its response times in the future.

As Vliet explained, a licensing service that operates outside of Xbox began to fail, leading to the various problems that impacted not only the console's user base, but also publishing and store partners who rely on the same services. To fix this, Microsoft's engineers isolated the failing infrastructure, redirected traffic, and continued to work toward disc
title: Microsoft’s Chaotic Server Outage Was Down To A Single Service Failure

author: Cheri Faulkner
description: When I think of creature-collector games, I think of the Pokemon series and, in more recent years, Palworld. Pokemon's decades-long dominance faced plenty of imitators throughout the years, until Palworld's monster-collecting, base-building, and weapon-crafting hit broke through. Since then, every new creature-collector game has to answer the same question: What makes that worth playing instead?
title: I Stopped Playing Palworld For This Creature-Collector Game

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Kratos has been the face of the God of War franchise for decades, but next year, the story is shifting from the Greek god-killer to his wife, Faye. God of War Laufey is the first game in the franchise to not feature Kratos as the protagonist, but beyond that, the game looks like it could hit all the right notes for what fans expect from the franchise with its mix of swords-and-sorcery action, beautiful visuals, and rich storytelling. Ahead of its release, here's everything that we know about God of War Laufey so far.

God of War Laufey release date
title: God Of War Laufey – Gameplay, Release Date, And Everything We Know So Far

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Marvel's Wolverine looks like it'll be one of the biggest games of September--which is a stacked month--as the new single-player adventure from Insomniac Games is aiming to put a fresh spin on the iconic mutant. At San Diego Comic-Con, multiple members of Insomniac hit the stage to talk about the game, the dark world that Marvel's Wolverine takes place in, and how the character has been modernized for his first solo outing since 2009. In case you missed it, here's a breakdown of all the new details revealed during the panel, ahead of the release of Marvel's Wolverine on September 15.

Earth-1048 is this Wolverine's home dimension
title: Marvel’s Wolverine: 13 New Details We Just Learned
